newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Bansud to issue 3-yr $100 mln bond.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Bansud to issue 3-yr $100 mln bond.

text.p: Argentina's Banco Bansud SA said Monday it will issue $100 million in three-year negotiable bonds.

The bank said in a statement to the Buenos Aires Stock Exchange ABN Amro Bank NV is arranging the issue, which will have a coupon of 9.25 percent and mature on Dec 13, 1999. Interest will be paid every six months.

The bond will be issued on Dec 13. The underwriters include ABN Amro, Bear Stearns International Ltd., Euro-American Capital Corp Ltd, UBS Ltd, BZW Ltd., Citibank International Plc and Chase Manhattan International Ltd.
The bond is part of Bansud's previously-announced $300 million medium-term bond program.
